context: Pin the truncation and the missing-becomes-zero fabrication in regression tests against the throughput capture path, carry float milliseconds and None-for-missing through capture, then confirm comparison and export behavior with the fixed producer. The fix belongs in the producer; comparison filtering must not change.
description: Residual defect from the 2026-08-09 adversarial review of PR #1644, verified on merged develop. benchbox/platforms/base/result_capture.py builds throughput query executions with execution_time_ms = int(float(query_result.get('execution_time_seconds', 0.0)) * 1000) (line 1556): every sub-millisecond successful query truncates to exactly 0 ms, and a missing duration is fabricated as 0.0 instead of None. PR #1644's comparison filter deliberately admits successful zero durations, so manufactured zeros skew comparison means and winner selection; a verified probe shows SUCCESS samples of 0 and 100.0 ms averaging 50.0. Preserve genuinely measured zeros but stop inventing them: carry float milliseconds without integer truncation and propagate None for missing durations. Export-side presentation rounding already exists in schema _round_duration_ms_for_export and must stay the only rounding authority.

anti_patterns.instead: Propagate None and let the canonical contract mark the duration missing.
anti_patterns.why: That fabricates a perfect measurement from absent data.

anti_patterns.dont: Re-add a magnitude filter in comparison to mask the truncation.
anti_patterns.instead: Fix the producer so zeros only appear when actually measured.
anti_patterns.why: The quality batch made zero a valid measured duration; masking hides the producer fidelity loss.

anti_patterns.dont: Round to integer milliseconds at capture time.
anti_patterns.instead: Carry float milliseconds and leave rounding to the export layer.
anti_patterns.why: Sub-millisecond successes are common in read-primitives workloads.

preserves.behavior: Canonical v2 export rounding behavior in schema is unchanged.
Comparison continues to admit genuinely measured zero durations for successful queries.
Non-throughput capture paths keep their existing duration precision.
Throughput stream position semantics stay stream-local as established by PR #1644.
